content_feed.telegram_post: 💵 #DIVIDEND | Railtel Corporation Of India Limited (NSE: RAILTEL) RailTel Board Approves Interim Dividend of Rs. 1 Per Share ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Dividend Amount: Rs. 1 per share (10% of paid-up capital) - Record Date: October 30, 2026 - Payment Date: November 20, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The board of directors approved the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and declared an interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
